subject.title: feat: add commands list and inspect inventory

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `openclaw commands` plus `effectProfile`, `commandExposure`, and `hidden` as a permanent public CLI/plugin descriptor contract, or keep this catalog work behind a narrower approved API design?
rationale: The PR is not only a read-only view: it reserves a core command root and expands a plugin-facing descriptor type, so implementation quality alone cannot determine the permanent compatibility contract.

options.title: Sponsor the catalog contract
options.body: Approve the CLI root and descriptor fields as supported surfaces, then require exact-head runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Keep the inventory internal or core-only until the RFC defines a stable plugin metadata contract.

options.title: Defer to the RFC
options.body: Pause this PR until the open command-catalog RFC records the intended public API and ownership boundaries.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the catalog contract
recommendation.body: Approve the CLI root and descriptor fields as supported surfaces, then require exact-head runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline’s direct mention and subscription provide the strongest available routing signal for this cross-cutting CLI and plugin API decision.
